response.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.equipstatus HAVING AVG(s.pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean1 FROM st), k1 AS (SELECT st.equipstatus, st.avg_pulse, st.avg_pulse - m1.mean1 AS excess1 FROM st CROSS JOIN m1 WHERE st.avg_pulse > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.avg_pulse, k1.excess1, k1.avg_pulse - m2.mean2 AS excess2 FROM k1 CROSS JOIN m2 WHERE k1.avg_pulse > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_pulse_final, AVG(excess1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k2

assumptions.assumption: Each status average is the plain average over its signals' pulse rates (nulls ignored). The means of the status averages are unweighted means across statuses, not weighted by signal count.
Statuses whose signals all have null pulse rates have no average and are excluded. A null equipstatus, if present, would form its own group.
The final row has NULL values if no status survives the second filter. This happens, for example, when every status has the same average.
